faq.question: How much does window replacement cost in Gilroy?
faq.answer: Gilroy homeowners typically invest $4,000 to $9,500 for a full window replacement project covering 10–16 windows. This South Valley city features a mix of older ranch homes near downtown and newer master-planned developments in the Glen Loma Ranch area. Standard sizing in newer developments makes for efficient, cost-effective projects. Single window installation starts at approximately $420.

faq.question: Do I need a permit to replace windows in Gilroy?
faq.answer: Yes. Gilroy requires a building permit for window replacements. Our team manages all permit applications with the City of Gilroy Building Division on your behalf.

faq.question: Is it worth replacing 20-year-old windows in Gilroy?
faq.answer: Often yes. Twenty-year-old windows in Gilroy commonly show fogged glass, drafts and weak locks. Newer ENERGY STAR units improve comfort and curb appeal; Deluxe Windows compares payback against your utility rates and home style before recommending replacement.

faq.question: Should I choose fiberglass or vinyl windows in Gilroy?
faq.answer: Vinyl is the value pick for most Gilroy replacements and handles Bay Area weather well. Fiberglass (including Marvin Ultrex) is stronger, more stable in temperature swings and better for larger openings or coastal exposure. We show both side by side in the showroom and on-site.

faq.question: How long does window replacement take in Gilroy?
faq.answer: Most Gilroy projects are measured in one visit and installed in one to three working days once products arrive — typically four to eight weeks after ordering, depending on brand and custom sizes.
